From the lab to the dashboard

I studied biochemistry, where every result starts with a question, a clean dataset and a careful reading of what the numbers do and don't prove. I bring that habit to business data.

Today I build dashboards and analyses in Power BI, SQL and Excel. I like projects where I have to clean the data, link the tables, and then explain what the numbers mean to someone who has to make a decision.

Projects

Capstone project, TS Academy

Logistics Pulse: fleet, safety and cost analytics

A four-page Power BI dashboard built on a 14-table logistics dataset. It shows leadership how the business is performing on revenue, deliveries, driver safety and fleet costs, with filters for customer type, city, year and incident type.

$263Mtotal revenue across 85K loads
55.67%on-time delivery rate
170incidents, $2.7M in claims
$0.79fleet cost per mile

Select the image to enlarge it.

Executive Summary

Revenue, miles, revenue per mile, MPG and loads, with the monthly revenue trend and top customers.

Delivery Performance

On-time rate, detention time by facility and on-time performance by customer.

Drivers and Safety

Incidents by type, at-fault rate, claim costs and monthly incident trend.

Fuel and Fleet Cost

Fuel spend, cost per mile by truck brand and maintenance cost by type and truck age.

One finding: maintenance spend is concentrated in the oldest trucks. 2015 models account for $824K, far more than any other model year.

Power BI project

CareMatrix: healthcare analytics

A two-page Power BI dashboard on hospital patient data. It shows who the patients are, how many are admitted, what care costs, and which hospitals, doctors, conditions and medications drive results. Filters cover gender, medical condition and age category.

40Kpatients, 54.966K admissions
$1.4bntotal billing
15.5average length of stay
51.5average patient age

Select the image to enlarge it.

Healthcare Overview

Patients, admissions, billing, length of stay, the patient journey, gender and age mix, and blood type by condition.

Hospital Performance

Top hospitals and doctors by patients, billing and recovery rate by condition, and medication use.

One finding: cancer has the highest recovery rate at 50%, while obesity has the lowest at 27%. Billing is almost even across conditions, between $0.23bn and $0.24bn each.

Internship project

Sales Performance Dashboard

A three-page dashboard that tracks sales and profit by category, payment method, customer, sub-category and state, with a written insights page. Filters cover year, category, state and payment method.

$6.18Mtotal sales
$1.61Mtotal profit
12.75Kunits sold
1,194orders

Select the image to enlarge it.

Sales Overview

Total sales, profit, quantity and orders, with sales by category, payment method, top customers and the yearly trend.

Detailed Analysis

Top sub-categories by sales and quantity, sales and profit by state, and the least profitable sub-categories.

Insight

A written summary of what the numbers mean for the business.

One finding: sales peaked at $1.5M in 2022 and then declined, but profit stayed between $0.2M and $0.4M the whole time. That points to a cost and margin problem hiding under the revenue numbers. Electronic Games and Printers sell well but are among the least profitable sub-categories.

Excel project

Financial Performance Dashboard

An Excel dashboard that tracks revenue, expenses, net profit and transactions from 2023 to mid-2025. Currency and transaction-type filters let you compare AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP and USD.

1.97Mtotal revenue
1.21Mtotal expenses
763Knet profit
2,000transactions

Select the image to enlarge it.

One finding: expenses make up 60% of transactions, yet revenue is still about 63% higher than expenses in total. GBP is the strongest currency, with the highest revenue (454,990) and the lowest expenses (217,574).
